SELECT from_bank, from_account, COUNT(*) AS n FROM aml.transactions
WHERE transaction_id <= 100000 AND transaction_time < TIMESTAMP '2022-08-02 00:00:00'
AND payment_format IN ('ACH','Wire') AND (from_bank <> to_bank OR from_account <> to_account)
GROUP BY from_bank, from_account ORDER BY n DESC, from_bank, from_account LIMIT 5
